scope: Observed file schema and receipts, not independent scientific validation

attributes.title: Kalmthout SWAP4.3.1 V02; numerical soil heat, WOFOST grass and maize proxy
attributes.model_scope: Locally refined 250m grid, independent1D soil columns; not calibrated; same groundwater priors as V01
attributes.source: SWAP4.3.1 original hydrological, thermal and WOFOST sources; explicit GNU output portability patch
attributes.time_convention: Native DATE labels the simulation day. time is the end of that UTC day; time_bounds is the complete preceding daily interval. State variables are at time; fluxes integrate over time_bounds.
attributes.output_depth_convention: Native selection returns compartment-centre values, without interpolation to requested depths. depth is the true signed depth; requested_depth records user selections.
attributes.assimilation_contract: GASST is native gross CH2O assimilation, not carbon GPP. Not simulated for prescribed vegetation. Zero assigned only for native unavailable GASST when no active dynamic crop; GASST_flag records this conversion.
attributes.balance_contract: BALDEV and DSTOR retain native definitions. independent_balance_residual compares fluxes with consecutive printed soil+pond+canopy stores; known crop-calendar canopy resets remain explicitly flagged.
attributes.crop_assumptions: {"cells": 4096, "crop_counts": {"prescribed": 2791, "grass": 802, "maize": 503}, "requested_output": "RAIN,RUNOFF,IRRIG,DRN,BOT,EPOT,EACT,TPOT,TACT,EPD,EIC,DSTOR,BALDEV,GASST,GWL,WC[-10.0;-20.0;-40.0;-80.0;-160.0],T[-10.0;-20.0;-40.0;-80.0;-160.0]", "crop_sources": "Original SWAP4.3.1 distribution data/crops/dynamic; archive SHA256 2b48353db6cdf00246a1e5c0dcaafc2c61858729fad18446a1dc66359ec2a360", "crop_overrides": {"SWCO2": 0, "SWSALINITY": 0}, "override_reasons": {"SWCO2": "No SSP5-8.5 projection substituted for historical CO2; source base response retained.", "SWSALINITY": "No solute simulation or observed salinity in this regional setup."}, "annual_crop_prior": "Maize annually 1May-15Oct; source germination and harvest switches retained; not observed crop rotation", "grass_prior": "Source WOFOST grass with annual calendar and biomass-dependent mowing; applies to mapped grass class, which may include unmanaged grass", "prescribed_vegetation": "Forest, heath, urban soil surrogate and wetland retain LAI route; GASST unavailable", "heat_initialization": {"surface_C": 7.5125, "200cm_C": 11.879371584699452, "basis": "First day and annual2024 mean of the same ERA5 air-temperature series; linear initial profile; no spin-up"}, "status": "PREPARED_NOT_YET_EXECUTED"}
attributes.spatial_limitations: Dominant terrestrial column only; water_fraction and landcover_input_flags retain mixed-water, urban-surrogate, soil-imputation and boundary-prior limitations. Not a complete lake or urban water balance.
